**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **No non-solicit or no-hire binds Customer anywhere in the MSA.** Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce" and "personnel" surface no restrictive covenant on Northwind's hiring; §30 (General), §16 (Confidentiality) and §12 are clean.
- **§12.3 goes further in our favour**, expressly preserving Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and confirming Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- This sits at the **preferred position** (no non-solicit on Customer), not merely the fallback, so there is nothing to narrow.
- Noted for context only: §12.4 restricts Vendor from developing a competing analytics service — a one-way restraint benefiting us, outside this rule's scope.
